pr_title: streamingccl: introduce a replication builtin crdb_internal.replication_stream_progress
pr_body:
Introduce a new builtin crdb_internal.replication_stream_progress
that can be used on the consumer side to report replication progress
to the source cluster and keeps the stream alive.

crdb_internal.replication_stream_progress(stream_id, frontier_ts):
stream_id is the id for the replication stream.
frontier_ts is the frontier timestamp until which the consumer has
made changes durable.

Fixes: #70925

Release note (sql): introduce a replication builtin
crdb_internal.replication_stream_progress(stream_id, frontier_ts).
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/73321)

issue_context.title: changefeedccl: Implement replication heartbeat mechanism
issue_context.body:
Implement `crdb_internal.replication_stream_progress(id, ts)` as described in
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1i7x6ce0SGMbJ3KEszeRVjRS0LaPhxulcUbi029nVy7c/edit#

This function is responsible for advancing stream job state on the source cluster; it functions as a way for the destination cluster to advance the PTS record forward, and to let the producer know that replication still happening.

Epic CRDB-6407
